items.title: CBRE (CBRE) Stock Still Looks Reasonable Following Its 82% Run
items.summary: CBRE Group has rallied over the past few years even as commercial property deal activity has been under pressure, which puts fresh focus on whether the current share price lines up with the cash the business can generate. With the stock closing at US$136.75 and the real estate cycle still adjusting to higher rates, the question is how firmly its cash flows support that tag. Over the past 3 years the share price is up 82.0%, so a lot of future cash generation is already being asked to carry...
